name: Mysterious Presence
summary: A willing creature you touch is shrouded for 1 minute: other creatures subtract 1d4 from Insight and Perception checks made against it.
text: You touch a willing creature and shroud its presence. Until the spell ends, other creatures must subtract 1d4 from any Wisdom (Insight or Perception) checks made against the target. Concentration, up to 1 minute.
